panes.title: Learned no-goods
panes.source:
(load-primitive-environment
  "examples/lain/amb/web_editor.clj"
  :examples.lain.amb.web-editor/primitive-bindings)

;; Add (-> (list 1 2) domain) with Extend to start this search.
(def-cells domain repairs decision)
(define chosen (amb domain repairs decision))
(define decisions (list decision))
(define valid (= chosen 2))
(define failure (require valid))
(define knowledge (learn failure decisions))
(-> (backtrack decisions knowledge) repairs)
(define learning (amb:learning-view knowledge))
(display learning)

panes.title: Published learning replay
panes.source:
(load-primitive-environment
  "examples/lain/amb/web_editor.clj"
  :examples.lain.amb.web-editor/primitive-bindings)
(load-lain "examples/lain/network_replay/collect-history.lain")

;; The existing recorder accumulates published semantic graphs and their values.
;; It does not claim to capture every internal learning operation.
(def-cells domain repairs decision)
(define chosen (amb domain repairs decision))
(define decisions (list decision))
(define valid (= chosen 2))
(define failure (require valid))
(define knowledge (learn failure decisions))
(-> (backtrack decisions knowledge) repairs)
(define learning (amb:learning-view knowledge))
(display (collect-semantic-history learning 0 600000))
